versions.content: Compatibility of ApplicationCompositeElementDat- aPrototype typed by primitive data type of category VALUE in a PPortPro- totype and a SystemSignal to which the ApplicationCompositeElement- DataPrototype is mapped by SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping If a VariableDataPrototype in a PPortPrototype typed by ApplicationCompos- iteDataType is mapped by a SenderReceiverToSignalGroupMapping to a SystemSignalGroup then the following conditions shall be fulfilled by an Appli- cationCompositeElementDataPrototype that is aggregated by the Applica- tionCompositeDataType and the SystemSignal of the SystemSignalGroup to which the ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype is mapped in case that the ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype is typed by an Appli- cationPrimitiveDataType of category VALUE: • the dataConstr s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Ap- plicationDataType of the ApplicationCompositeElementDataProto- type are compatible to the dataConstr s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [constr_9373]. • the compuMethod s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Ap- plicationDataType of the ApplicationCompositeElementDataProto- type is compatible to the compuMethod of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [constr_9372]. • the unit s of AutosarDataType.swDataDefProps defined on Applica- tionDataType of the ApplicationCompositeElementDataPrototype is compatible to the unit s of SystemSignal.physicalProps according to [constr_1052] defined in [4].
